# The checks, in one table

<!-- doc: generated by tools/checks_index.py; edit the tools, not this file -->

What `tools/smoke.py` runs before every restart, in the order it runs it, and
what is run by hand. A check that *stops* fails smoke and refuses the restart; one
that is *reported* prints and goes on. The tool column is the subprocess the check
runs, where it is one; the rest are inline in smoke.

## Smoke, in order

|---|---|---|---|

| 3 | every prompt file a role names |  | stops |
| 4 | names that are used but never set, and broken + chains |  | stops |
| 5 | a tool a program starts carries the character's config |  | stops |

| 7 | every registered character has a bundle, and it agrees with her row | `tools/registry.py` | stops |

| 11 | a character whose config names none of a person's files still builds | `tools/blank_paths.py` | stops |
| 12 | the mechanism codebook loads, its neighbours resolve, and nobody is named | `tools/codebook_check.py` | stops |
| 13 | a day of a character who runs herself, beside the one who keeps her world | `tools/agent_rehearsal.py` | stops |
